text.text: This page is where the practice keeps its calendar honest: clients and engagements, the monthly close for each, the filing deadlines coming up and the documents still owed. It tracks work only and gives no tax or financial advice. Start on the Dashboard, then work Overdue and Mine.

text.text: A repeatable close is the product. Clients buy not having to think about it.
Day one to three
Create the close row for each client and set Documents due and Package due.
Send the document request with a clear list and a date.
Chase anything missing on day three with a phone call, not another email.
Bookkeeping
Reconcile every bank and card account to the statement.
Review uncategorized transactions and ask the client about anything unusual.
Post payroll and check sales tax accounts.
Review
Reconciliations tie to statements
No unexplained balances
Month-over-month changes explained
A second person has looked at the numbers
Delivery
Send the package with two or three sentences on what changed, then press Deliver package.
Setting up
Add every recurring deadline per client at onboarding: payroll, sales tax, estimates and annual filings.
Give each a preparer and a due date, and confirm both with the client.
Working it
Check Deadlines in the next 14 days every Monday.
Anything Upcoming within seven days gets a preparer and a plan.
When a deadline cannot be met, record an extension request and tell the client why.
After filing
Press Record filing and note the confirmation number.
Save the copy in the client folder.
This template tracks the work. The rules for each filing come from your professional guidance and the authorities concerned.
Week one
Engagement letter signed and fee set on the client row
Access to bank feeds and accounting software confirmed
Prior year records and opening balances requested
Deadlines for the year added to the calendar
Week two
Review the books they already have and list every clean-up item.
Agree the document routine: where files go, who sends, by which day.
First close
Run the first close slowly. Write down every question you had to ask, and turn the answers into the checklist on the client page.
The ladder

cells.text: Send a request with a list and a date
Friendly reminder; set the row to Reminded
Phone call, and offer to help locate the file
Escalate to the owner and warn what will be late

text.text: Making it easier
Ask for a few documents at a time, not thirty.
Offer a secure upload link and say how long it takes.
Thank them as soon as something arrives, and press Log arrival.
